label: an infinite head width, period, span or window passes the positive guard
zero passes the positive guard
a refused non-positive value is told that zero was admissible
a non-finite azimuth is left for the magnitude comparison to refuse
equivalent: EQUIVALENT by the arithmetic of the comparison, not by what the tests contain. Both forms return the same `Result` for every f64. The accept branch needs `azimuth.abs() <= FRAC_PI_2`, and IEEE-754 makes that false for every non-finite input: |NaN| is NaN and every ordered comparison with NaN is false, |+-inf| is inf which is greater than pi/2. So `is_finite()` removes nothing from the accept set and adds nothing to the reject set, and the Err it would have raised early carries the identical what/value/low/high as the one the magnitude comparison raises. Checked by building both versions side by side and comparing the returned bits (discriminant, value bits, bound bits) over 40,000,000 random 64-bit patterns covering every class (quiet and signalling NaN of both signs, both infinities, subnormals, normals), 24 named special values (+-0.0, +-pi/2, +-MIN_POSITIVE, +-5e-324, MAX, MIN, EPSILON, five NaN payloads), and the 4000 representable values either side of +-pi/2: 0 disagreements. The guard is redundant, not inert in the way a dead branch is: it states the intent, and it is the same shape as the positive() guard where dropping is_finite() IS observable (inf > 0.0 is true) -- so the two are not one finding.

equivalent: UNREACHABLE, and deliberately so. `coincidences` now refuses a non-positive `window` at its first statement (the entry 'a bypassed window is not re-checked at the point of use' pins that guard and comes back `caught`), and with `window > 0` the pull-forward cannot change the answer. Proof from the walk: `hi < lo` requires the high pointer to have stopped at some index k on an earlier left spike, so `right[k] + delta > tl' + window`, and the low pointer to have since passed k, so `right[k] + delta < tl - window`. The `while` that follows starts from that same old `hi` and advances while `right[hi] + delta <= tl + window`; every index the low pointer passed satisfies `right[i] + delta < tl - window <= tl + window`, so the loop walks through all of them and finishes at exactly the index the pull-forward would have started it from. The final `hi` is identical either way, so `hi - lo` is identical. The line matters only for a NEGATIVE window, where without it `hi - lo` wraps and the detector reports 18,446,744,073,709,551,615 coincidences — and that input no longer reaches the walk. MEASURED: 200,000 random (left, right, delays, window>0) cases, 0 differences and 0 wraps; the same fixture with window = -1.0 wraps without the line and is refused with the guard. The line is kept as defence in case the guard is ever relaxed, and this argument's premise is that guard, whose own mutation is caught.
